added.n: Overlay Controller Xbox Series X - Lime Drip Lines Edition
added.ne: Xbox Series X Controller Overlay - Lime Drip Lines Edition
added.d: Edisi overlay controller Xbox Series X bertema Lime Drip Lines yang bergerak mengikuti gamepad. Tombol, stik, dan trigger ikut bereaksi saat ditekan. Untuk OBS atau Streamlabs.
added.de: Xbox Series X controller overlay, Lime Drip Lines theme, that moves along with your gamepad. Buttons, sticks and triggers react when pressed. For OBS or Streamlabs.
ft: Body bergambar goresan hijau lime neon dengan efek tetesan
Tetesan lime kecil jatuh pelan di sisi kiri body
Trigger terisi cat lime seperti tuangan saat ditarik
Bumper dan tombol menyala lime penuh saat ditekan
Stik karet hijau lime dengan cincin charcoal
Daily Streak: hitungan hari main berturut-turut di plat atas dan layar Home
Suasana body makin terang mengikuti intensitas permainan
Warna aksen tombol dan stik bisa diganti lewat pengaturan
fte: Body artwork with neon lime brush strokes and drip effects
Small lime drips slowly fall on the left side of the body
Triggers fill with lime paint like a pour when pulled
Bumpers and buttons light up solid lime when pressed
Green lime rubber sticks with charcoal rings
Daily Streak: consecutive play day counter on the top plate and Home display
Body mood gets brighter with play intensity
Button and stick accent color can be changed in settings
